map.保险（责任/意外/雇主）推荐是做什么的？: What does Insurance (Liability / Accident / Employer) Recommendation do?
map.如何使用保险（责任/意外/雇主）推荐？: How do I use Insurance (Liability / Accident / Employer) Recommendation?
map.保险（责任/意外/雇主）推荐适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Insurance (Liability / Accident / Employer) Recommendation best for?
map.📖 查看「保险（责任/意外/雇主）推荐使用指南」: 📖 View the "Insurance (Liability / Accident / Employer) Recommendation Guide"
map.保额按需求法估算：寿险保额 = 年收入 × 5 至 10 倍 + 负债 − 已有: Coverage is estimated by the needs method: life insurance coverage = annual income × 5 to 10 + liabilities − existing savings and coverage; accident insurance coverage is usually 5 to 10 times annual income; critical-illness coverage = treatment cost of about 300,000 to 500,000 CNY + 3 to 5 years of lost income; employer liability insurance premium = total annual employee payroll × industry rate.
map.为家庭或个人梳理保障缺口时，先按场景生成建议清单，再逐项核对是否已有对应保单。: When reviewing coverage gaps for a family or individual, first generate a scenario-based list of suggestions, then check item by item whether a matching policy already exists.
map.小微企业经营前对财产、雇主与公众责任做一轮保障盘点，作为投保沟通的准备。: Before running a small business, do a round of coverage stocktaking for property, employer and public liability as preparation for talking to an insurer.
map.给客户讲解保障思路时，用生成的场景化建议辅助说明，避免遗漏常见责任类型。: When explaining coverage ideas to clients, use the generated scenario-based suggestions to support the discussion and avoid missing common liability types.
map.设定生成数量 5，页面从家庭财产、个人意外、雇主责任、公众责任、旅行出行等场景中: Set the count to 5 and the page combines scenarios such as household property, personal accident, employer liability, public liability and travel, outputting the matching insurance type and a common coverage range for each as a starting point for stocktaking.
map.保额区间仅为参考: Coverage ranges are for reference only
map.页面给出的保额区间为常见范围示例，实际保额应结合收入、负债与家庭责任测算，不能直: The coverage ranges shown are example common ranges; the actual amount should be calculated from income, liabilities and family responsibilities and should not be copied directly.
map.生成的建议能直接投保吗？: Can the generated suggestions be used to buy insurance directly?
map.不能。页面仅生成保障思路与险种示例，不含任何真实报价与条款；投保请以保险公司正式: No. The page only generates coverage ideas and example insurance types and contains no real quotes or terms; buying insurance is governed by the insurer's formal terms and underwriting result.
map.不会。全部在浏览器本地生成，服务端不接收输入，也不做任何用户画像。: No. Everything is generated locally in the browser and the server receives no input and does no user profiling.
map.保额怎么定更合理？: How should coverage be set more sensibly?
map.常见做法是按责任缺口倒推：先估算家庭必要支出与负债，再扣除已有保障与储蓄，差额即: A common approach is to work backward from the responsibility gap: first estimate essential household spending and liabilities, then subtract existing coverage and savings, and the difference is the reference coverage.
